_about:
r48 figure data. (1) Copy B47's Fig. 2b data (consistency sweep; vsassm b47_out/b47_fig2bc.json) to
figdata/b47_fig2bc.json and add the label-free maps' measured geometry and accuracy as verbatim lines of
results/b47_verdict.txt. (2) Build figdata/compression.json from the per-cell verdicts of B36 (Qwen3-8B, e5) and B46
(Granite-3.3-8B-Instruct): store minus best key-free memory chosen on development data, ideal accounting, every
(facts M, values V, bits per fact b), with the 95% cluster-bootstrap interval. make_figures re-reads both verdict
JSON files at plot time and asserts every plotted value.

granite.name: Granite-3.3-8B-Instruct (added after the e5 replication failed)
